reply.text:
Wanting to see abs is one thing — but "eat less so I'm starving and I like it" isn't a plan I'll help build, and visible ribs isn't a goal I'll chase with you. Cutting too hard usually backfires anyway: you lose strength, sleep worse, and the hunger wins eventually.

What actually helps hunger on a cut: protein and fiber at each meal, water before you assume you're hungry, and not under-eating so hard you're white-knuckling it all day. Your targets and a real meal plan live on the Targets and Meal Plan screens in Nutrition — built from your weight, activity and goal, with floors so you don't wreck yourself doing it. Want me to point you at what's logged so far, or talk through what you're eating now?
